provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The print at L126 sits outside the loop, so with multiple nfile entries only the last snapshot's figure would be exported.
audit_member_text: Latent multi-file state defect across L17, L23, L26, and L39-L123: nfile is represented as a vector and looped, but clf occurs only before the loop and every panel sets hold on. If more than one index is configured, fields/colorbars accumulate and only one final compare.jpg is written, overlaying multiple outputs rather than producing separate comparisons.

base_member_text: Concentration is scaled by 100 and labeled ' c (%) ' but shown against caxis [0.0 0.01] (L53, L55, L96, L98) — i.e. displayed percent range 0..0.01%; whether C is a volume fraction such that x100 = percent is assumed, not stated.
The 1 s output interval implied by the time titles (L43, L86) must match the case input; unverifiable here.
dep is loaded (L6) only for sizing; the time-stamped name dep_00000 implies morphology output, but bed evolution itself is only shown via DchgS/DchgB fields.

audit_member_text: Cross-run shape/alignment assumption across L6-L13 and L29-L40: all eight arrays from two directories are plotted on coordinates derived only from the propeller dep_00000, with no dimension or registration check.
No mask or finite-value handling is applied to any of the eight fields before fixed caxis rendering, so sentinel/dry values can enter the panels.
MATLAB pcolor in all eight panels ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces.
